prompts.text: Write a haiku about autumn leaves.
Give me a quiet three-line haiku about snow at dawn.
Write exactly two rhyming lines about a sleepy cat.
Make a rhyming couplet about spring rain, rather than a haiku.
Reformat April 5, 2026 as an ISO 8601 calendar date.
Explain what a haiku is; do not write a poem.
How many feet does a spider have?
Explain what ISO 8601 means; there is no date to convert.
